title: Full-chat transcript recovery and ingestion

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive: when a conversation ends abruptly and is copied/pasted into a new chat, recover all useful work, verify persistence, write through to GitHub/Drive, feed reusable learning into the work engine and Self-Improvement Engine, then continue

source_provenance.notes: Deterministic first-pass extractor merged through PR #59

problem_or_opportunity: Abrupt conversation endings can strand Founder decisions, chat-only artifacts, completed-work claims and reusable system improvements. Manual reconstruction by the Founder is slow, error-prone and can lose work or promote stale claims.
proposed_mechanism: Treat pasted/exported prior conversations as recovery corpora. Deterministically extract a secret-redacted recovery ledger, then semantically reconcile Founder directives, persisted-artifact claims, chat-only outputs, open gates and reusable improvements against current GitHub/Drive authority before write-through and continuation.
expected_benefit: Reduces cross-chat context loss and Founder orchestration burden while preventing false saved/locked/PASS claims, stale overwrites, secret leakage and loss of reusable learning.

protected_invariants: Transcript is recovery evidence, never automatic canon
No overwrite of newer persisted work
Final transcript tail must be processed before INGESTION_COMPLETE
development_contract.machine_boundary: Deterministic extractor produces EXTRACTED_UNVERIFIED only; AI/editorial reconciliation and connector readback remain required.

pilot_evidence: Concurrent main advances forced branch+PR integration rather than stale force overwrite; PR #59 merged successfully
red_team_findings: A deterministic parser cannot decide canon or semantic authority and therefore must fail closed at EXTRACTED_UNVERIFIED
A pasted transcript may contain credentials; secret redaction must occur before excerpts are persisted
A previous model claiming that it saved/locked/passed something is a claim, not persistence evidence
Do not retroactively claim the extension exists inside an older packaged ZIP
application_targets: Google Drive 18B mirror and current Self-Improvement router mirror
verification_evidence: Tested tool Git blob SHA 79b9cd9f9b8e60f65a7ec156dc23689a194233a6 matched GitHub main readback
Drive 18B protocol and current Self-Improvement router were updated with runtime evidence and read back
next_action: Use on the first real large pasted prior-conversation corpus, complete persisted-source reconciliation, and record recovery defects/successes in the Learning Ledger. Compact this record into CURRENT_IMPROVEMENT_REGISTRY.json when an atomic registry-write path is available without risking loss of existing one-line registry content.
notes: Extension itself is VERIFIED_CURRENT. Central-registry compaction remains a storage-hygiene task; this shard preserves the full candidate record without rewriting or truncating the existing seven-candidate registry.

registry_write_through.reason: Current registry is stored as one very large minified line. Connector has whole-file replacement semantics; preserving all existing candidate detail takes priority over risky reconstruction.
